title: Short-Sleeve Cotton Baby Bodysuits, Pack of 5
description:
Everyday bodysuits in soft, breathable cotton that layer easily under sleepsuits and dungarees. The envelope neckline slips over the head without a struggle, and press studs at the crotch keep nappy changes quick.
• Material: 100% cotton jersey, 180 g/m²
• Pack contents: 5 bodysuits in white, grey melange and sage
• Envelope shoulders and 3 nickel-free press studs
• Machine washable at 40 °C; tumble dry on low

title: Baby Dungarees with Bunny Print and Long-Sleeve Top, 2-Piece Set
description:
A playful two-piece outfit: printed dungarees with a bunny patch on the bib, paired with a matching long-sleeve top. Press studs along the inside legs make changes simple.
• Material: 95% cotton, 5% elastane
• Set includes dungarees and a long-sleeve top
• Adjustable shoulder straps with two button positions
• Machine washable at 30 °C

title: Knitted Baby Beanie Hat with Bear Ears
description:
A snug knitted beanie with two little bear ears that keeps small heads cosy on walks and chilly days. The fold-up ribbed brim lets the hat grow with your baby.
• Material: 70% cotton, 30% acrylic, soft double knit
• Sizes: 0–6 months (head 36–42 cm), 6–18 months (head 42–48 cm)
• Fold-up ribbed brim for a longer fit
• Machine washable at 30 °C on a gentle cycle

title: Wide-Neck Baby Feeding Bottles 260 ml, Set of 2
description:
Two wide-neck bottles that are easy to fill, clean and hold. The soft silicone teat has a broad base, and a small vent lets air in while your baby drinks.
• Capacity: 260 ml each, with millilitre markings
• Material: BPA-free polypropylene bottle, food-grade silicone teat
• Includes 2 bottles, 2 teats, 2 screw rings and 2 travel caps
• Dishwasher safe (top rack) and suitable for steam sterilising

title: Silicone Baby Bib with Deep Food Catcher
description:
A soft, waterproof bib with a deep pocket that catches crumbs and spills before they reach the floor. It wipes clean in seconds, ready for the next meal.
• Material: food-grade silicone, BPA-free
• Adjustable neck strap with 4 press-stud positions
• Suitable from about 6 months to 3 years
• Rinse under the tap or wash in the dishwasher

title: Bamboo Weaning Set with Suction Plate, Bowl and Spoons
description:
A natural bamboo weaning set for the first steps into solid food. The divided plate and the bowl have silicone suction rings that hold them in place on a high-chair tray or table.
• Includes a divided plate, a bowl and 2 silicone-tip spoons, plus 1 spare suction ring
• Plate 22 × 18 cm; bowl 12 cm diameter, 300 ml
• Material: natural bamboo with food-grade silicone
• Hand wash in warm soapy water; not for microwave or dishwasher

title: Hooded Baby Bath Towel with Ears, 80 × 80 cm
description:
A generous hooded towel that wraps your baby up warm straight after bath time. The hood keeps a damp head covered and has two sewn-on ears.
• Size: 80 × 80 cm, from birth to about 3 years
• Material: 100% cotton, muslin outer with a terry inner layer
• Hood with decorative ears
• Machine washable at 60 °C

title: Reusable Cloth Nappies with Bamboo Inserts, Pack of 3
description:
One-size pocket nappies that adjust with press studs to fit from about 3.5 to 15 kg. Each nappy has a waterproof outer and a soft inner lining, with an absorbent insert that slides into the pocket.
• Pack contents: 3 nappy covers and 3 bamboo-viscose inserts
• Outer: waterproof PUL fabric; lining: microfleece
• Adjustable rise and waist with press studs
• Machine wash at 40–60 °C; line dry

title: Baby Bath Tub with Non-Slip Backrest and Drain Plug
description:
A sturdy bath tub shaped to hold your baby in a comfortable semi-reclined position, leaving your hands free for washing. The plug in the base lets you empty it without lifting.
• Size: 82 × 48 × 24 cm, from birth to about 12 months
• Material: BPA-free polypropylene with rubber non-slip feet
• Moulded backrest and drain plug
• Always stay within arm's reach of your baby during bath time

title: Stroller Organiser Bag with Detachable Shoulder Strap
description:
A roomy organiser that hangs from the stroller handlebar and keeps keys, bottles, wipes and your phone close at hand. Unclip it and it doubles as a small shoulder bag.
• Size: 34 × 15 × 14 cm
• Material: faux leather (PU) outer with a water-resistant lining
• 2 bottle pockets, a zipped main section and an outside phone pocket
• Fits most stroller handles with 2 adjustable straps

title: Reversible Cotton Stroller Seat Liner
description:
A padded liner that adds a soft, washable layer to strollers and pushchairs. It is reversible, with a plain side and a patterned side, and has harness slots for 3- and 5-point straps.
• Size: 80 × 35 cm with 1.5 cm padding
• Material: 100% cotton cover, polyester filling
• Harness slots for 3- and 5-point systems
• Machine washable at 30 °C

title: Soft Plush Teddy Bear, 30 cm
description:
A cuddly teddy bear in extra-soft plush, with an embroidered face so there are no small parts to come loose. Just the right size for little arms to carry around.
• Height: 30 cm (sitting)
• Material: polyester plush with polyester fibre filling
• Embroidered eyes and nose, no buttons or beads
• Machine washable at 30 °C in a laundry bag
• Ages 0+ (suitable from birth)

title: Wooden Xylophone for Toddlers with Two Mallets
description:
A colourful xylophone that invites little ones to tap out their first tunes. Each metal key plays a different note, and the wooden mallets are sized for small hands.
• Size: 30 × 13 × 4 cm with 8 colour-coded metal keys
• Material: wooden base finished with water-based paint
• Includes 2 wooden mallets
• Ages 18 months+

title: Floating Bath Ducks in Assorted Colours, Set of 10
description:
A set of brightly coloured ducks that bob on the water and make bath time more fun. Each duck is fully sealed with no hole, so no water gets trapped inside.
• Set of 10 ducks, each about 6 cm long
• Material: BPA-free soft vinyl
• Sealed design; rinse and air dry after use
• Ages 6 months+

title: Hanging Cot Mobile with Felt Sheep and Wooden Bar
description:
A calm mobile with soft felt sheep that turn gently in the air above the cot or changing table. The neutral colours suit any nursery.
• Wooden hanging bar 40 cm, drop length about 60 cm
• Material: wool-blend felt, beech wood and cotton thread
• Ceiling hook included
• Hang out of baby's reach and remove once your baby can push up on hands and knees
• Ages 0+

title: Cable-Knit Cotton Baby Blanket, 80 × 100 cm
description:
A soft cable-knit blanket for the cot, the stroller or the play mat. The breathable cotton knit keeps it comfortable in every season.
• Size: 80 × 100 cm
• Material: 100% cotton knit
• Classic cable pattern with a ribbed border
• Machine washable at 30 °C on a wool cycle; dry flat

title: Socket Safety Covers for EU Wall Sockets, Pack of 24
description:
Plug-in covers that block unused wall sockets so curious fingers and small objects stay out. They push in firmly and come out again with the removal key.
• Pack contents: 24 covers and 2 removal keys
• Fits standard EU Type E and Type F wall sockets
• Material: white ABS plastic
• Flush, low-profile design

title: Adhesive Cabinet and Drawer Safety Locks, Pack of 10
description:
Flexible strap locks that keep cupboards, drawers and appliance doors shut against little explorers, while adults release them with one press. They stick on in seconds with no drilling.
• Pack contents: 10 strap locks and 2 spare adhesive pads
• Adjustable strap length up to 22 cm
• Strong adhesive pads for wood, glass and metal
• Fits cabinets, drawers, fridges and toilet lids

title: Maternity Shirt Dress with Tie Waist
description:
A relaxed button-front shirt dress cut with extra room through the bump, so it fits throughout pregnancy and after. The full button front makes it practical for nursing too.
• Material: 100% viscose, light and airy
• Full button front, two chest pockets and roll-up sleeves
• Removable tie belt for an adjustable fit
• Knee length; machine washable at 30 °C

title: Seamless Maternity Leggings with Over-Bump Waistband
description:
Soft, stretchy leggings with a tall waistband that sits comfortably over the bump and grows with you from early pregnancy onwards. The opaque fabric works for everyday wear and light activity.
• Material: 92% polyamide, 8% elastane, opaque
• Seamless over-bump panel, 30 cm high
• Full length with flat seams
• Machine washable at 30 °C
